baseline: per-task most common training answer, lexical tie break; no test labels or pretrained models

data.admission: Same verified numeric facts/texts/families/splits, with content-bound generator revision, split seed and transformation lineage in each item; new identities do not rewrite parent evidence.
data.order: Retain ordering_identity equal to each parent example identity; rank training rows by SHA256 canonical JSON of seed and that identity, preserving prior numerical exposure.

decision: Choose constant 0.001 and 4096 updates after all nine exposed dense budget cells pass per-task training checks; all three lanes start fresh with matched settings; no new outcome-based tuning.
diagnostics: train only; inherited validation history aliases training examples; no validation/test model calls during updates
evaluation: All 27 training workers terminate first. One fresh evaluation worker verifies all training checkpoints and regenerates predictions/loss, writes the decision, and evaluates the full matrix only if eligible. It validates authorization once for the whole bounded matrix, not by caching verifier success.

gates.cost_margin: paired training wall ratio <=1.25; latent float32 byte ratio <=1; descriptive only
gates.failure: any missing/failed worker or invalid pairing suppresses aggregates; dense train floor failure blocks held-out scoring for every lane
gates.learning_adequate: all seeds, all tasks: train >=0.90, held-out >=0.50 and held-out >= training-majority baseline +0.10
gates.quality_margin: quantized minus dense held-out family macro >=-0.05; interpret only with useful dense learning gate
gates.test_unlock: all dense workload/seed cells verified and every task train exact answer+EOS >=0.90; all 27 training workers terminate first; decision retained before any held-out evaluation

phase5: Passing dense learning gates permits scoping a separately frozen controlled intervention; no automatic geometry objective or release unlock.
primary: final-step unconstrained greedy complete answer plus EOS; per-task and family macro accuracy; all seeds retained
scope: Exploratory family-held-out characterization on visible finite foundations fixtures; no fresh confirmatory general reasoning, independent-host replication, quantum advantage or packed savings.
selection: final update only; no early stopping, validation selection, test tuning or automatic format selection

training.selection: final-step; no early stopping; no test evaluation

uncertainty: raw counts, paired seed differences, mean/min/max; descriptive only
